53	/**
54	 * Sanitize merchant-supplied custom CSS before embedding it in a storefront
55	 * <style> element. Strips known injection vectors:
56	 *   - </style> close tags  — would break out of the enclosing style block
57	 *   - @import directives   — would load arbitrary external stylesheets
58	 *   - expression()         — IE-era JS-in-CSS execution vector
59	 *   - javascript: URLs     — covers url(javascript:...) and similar
60	 */
61	function sanitizeCss(css: string): string {
62	  return css
63	    // Break out of <style> blocks — strip both opening and closing tags
64	    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>/gi, "")
65	    .replace(/<\/style>/gi, "")
66	    // External stylesheet loading
67	    .replace(/@import\b[^;]*(;|$)/gi, "")
68	    // IE expression() — JS execution inside CSS property values
69	    .replace(/\bexpression\s*\(/gi, "")
70	    // javascript: protocol inside url() references
71	    .replace(/url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*javascript\s*:/gi, "url(")
72	    // data: URIs inside url() — can embed arbitrary content including scripts
73	    .replace(/url\s*\(\s*['"]?\s*data\s*:/gi, "url(");
74	}

77	  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
78	    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS_HEADERS });
79	  }
80	
81	  const url = new URL(request.url);
82	  const shop = url.searchParams.get("shop");
83	
84	  if (!shop) {
85	    return new Response(
86	      JSON.stringify({ error: "Missing shop parameter" }),
87	      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
88	    );
89	  }
90	
91	  // Validate shop is a real myshopify.com domain (prevents cross-shop config enumeration)
92	  if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.myshopify\.com$/.test(shop) || shop.length > 100) {
93	    return new Response(
94	      JSON.stringify({ error: "Invalid shop parameter" }),
95	      { status: 400, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
96	    );
97	  }
98	
99	  let config, subscription;
100	  try {
101	    [config, subscription] = await Promise.all([
102	      db.widgetConfig.findUnique({ where: { shop } }),
103	      getShopSubscription(shop),
104	    ]);
105	  } catch {
106	    return new Response(
107	      JSON.stringify({ error: "Internal server error" }),
108	      { status: 500, headers: CORS_HEADERS },
109	    );
110	  }
111	
112	  const limits = subscription.limits;
113	
114	  const raw = config
115	    ? {
116	        position: config.position,
117	        primaryColor: config.primaryColor,
118	        successColor: config.successColor,
119	        errorColor: config.errorColor,
120	        backgroundColor: config.backgroundColor,
121	        textColor: config.textColor,
122	        heading: config.heading,
123	        placeholder: config.placeholder,
124	        buttonText: config.buttonText,
125	        successMessage: config.successMessage,
126	        errorMessage: config.errorMessage,
127	        notFoundMessage: config.notFoundMessage,
128	        showEta: config.showEta,
129	        showZone: config.showZone,
130	        showWaitlistOnFailure: config.showWaitlistOnFailure,
131	        showCod: config.showCod ?? true,
132	        showReturnPolicy: config.showReturnPolicy ?? true,
133	        showCutoffTime: config.showCutoffTime ?? true,
134	        showDeliveryDays: config.showDeliveryDays ?? true,
135	        showDeliveryDate: config.showDeliveryDate ?? true,
136	        showCountdown: config.showCountdown ?? true,
137	        showDeliveryFee: config.showDeliveryFee ?? true,
138	        blockCartOnInvalid: config.blockCartOnInvalid ?? false,
139	        showSocialProof: config.showSocialProof ?? true,
140	        lockButtonsUntilZipCheck: config.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck ?? true,
141	        borderRadius: config.borderRadius,
142	        customCss: config.customCss ? sanitizeCss(config.customCss) : null,
143	      }
144	    : DEFAULTS;
145	
146	  // Server-side enforcement: strip features the plan doesn't include
147	  const payload = {
148	    ...raw,
149	    // Free plan: reset colors to defaults (position is already "inline" in DB
150	    // for free-plan shops since the admin UI disables the position selector)
151	    ...(limits.widgetFullCustom
152	      ? {}
153	      : {

155	          successColor: DEFAULTS.successColor,
156	          errorColor: DEFAULTS.errorColor,
157	          backgroundColor: DEFAULTS.backgroundColor,
158	          textColor: DEFAULTS.textColor,
159	        }),

161	    ...(limits.showEtaCodReturn ? {} : {
162	      showEta: false,
163	      showZone: false,
164	      showCod: false,
165	      showReturnPolicy: false,
166	      showCutoffTime: false,
167	      showDeliveryDays: false,

## Complete Pinzo Shopify App - Full Documentation

### PROJECT OVERVIEW
Pinzo is a comprehensive Shopify app that enables merchants to manage delivery by zip code. It provides features for checking delivery availability, managing delivery zones, setting delivery rules, capturing waitlist signups, and fully customizing the widget that appears on the storefront.

---

### DIRECTORY STRUCTURE

```

├── app/
│   ├── routes/                    # All route handlers (22 route files)
│   ├── utils/                     # Utility functions
│   ├── root.tsx                   # Root React layout
│   ├── entry.server.tsx           # Server entry point
│   ├── routes.ts                  # Route configuration
│   ├── shopify.server.ts          # Shopify app setup
│   ├── db.server.ts               # Database singleton
│   ├── billing.server.ts          # Billing logic
│   ├── email.server.ts            # Email service (Resend)
│   ├── plans.ts                   # Plan definitions
│   ├── globals.d.ts               # Type definitions
│   └── plans.ts                   # Pricing tiers
├── extensions/zip-code-widget/    # Storefront theme extension

├── shopify.app.toml               # Main app config

```

---

### CORE CONFIGURATION FILES

#### **package.json**
- Node version: >=20.19 <22 || >=22.12
- Framework: React Router 7 + Shopify App React Router
- Database ORM: Prisma 6.19.2
- Styling: Shopify Polaris 13.9.5
- Email: Resend 6.9.4
- Custom: @boldteq/agents (local SDK)

#### **shopify.app.toml**
```toml
client_id = "467630f9b523b4327258fcda08ecaac9"
name = "Pinzo"
application_url = "https://zip-code-checker-production-b1a0.up.railway.app"
embedded = true

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-01"
- app/scopes_update
- app/uninstalled
- app_subscriptions/update

[access_scopes]
scopes = "read_themes"
```

#### **prisma/schema.prisma**
Database models:
- **Session**: OAuth session storage
- **ZipCode**: Allowed/blocked zip codes with metadata (ETA, zone, COD, return policy)
- **DeliveryRule**: Zone-based rules (fees, minimums, cutoff times, schedules, priorities)
- **WaitlistEntry**: Customer emails waiting for delivery to new areas
- **WidgetConfig**: Merchant-configured widget settings (colors, text, toggles, custom CSS)
- **Subscription**: Billing subscription state
- **ShopSettings**: Merchant settings (notification email, email sender name, default behavior)
- **FeatureRequest**: Community feature voting system
- **FeatureVote**: Votes on feature requests

---

### ROOT FILES

#### **app/root.tsx**
Minimal HTML layout with Outlet, Links, Meta, Scripts. No styling wrapper.

#### **app/entry.server.tsx**
- Rendersto-stream with 5s timeout
- CSP modification for Chatwoot live-chat widget
- Bot detection with `isbot`
- Response headers managed by Shopify

#### **app/routes.ts**
Uses React Router's `flatRoutes()` for file-based routing from `/routes` directory.

---

### SERVER FILES

#### **app/shopify.server.ts** (124 lines)
Shopify app initialization:
- API version: `January26` (2026-01)
- Auth: PrismaSessionStorage
- Billing plans configured with trial days (7)
- Exported functions: `authenticate`, `login`, `registerWebhooks`, `unauthenticated`

**Plans:**
- Starter Monthly: $4.99/month
- Starter Annual: $39/year
- Pro Monthly: $9.99/month
- Pro Annual: $79/year
- Ultimate Monthly: $19.99/month
- Ultimate Annual: $149/year

#### **app/db.server.ts**
Prisma singleton pattern with global cache for dev mode.

#### **app/billing.server.ts**
- `getShopSubscription()`: Get or create subscription record
- `syncSubscriptionFromShopify()`: Sync Shopify billing state to DB
- `cancelShopSubscription()`: Revert to free plan
- Exports all plan constants

#### **app/email.server.ts** (245 lines)
Email service using Resend API:
- `sendWaitlistConfirmation()`: Customer confirmation email
- `sendMerchantWaitlistAlert()`: Merchant notification
- `sendZipAvailableNotification()`: Customer zip availability notice
- `sendTestEmail()`: Settings page test email
- All functions return boolean (no throwing)
- Branded layout with Pinzo logo and store name
- Respects custom sender name, reply-to address

#### **app/utils/agent.server.ts** (173 lines)
Claude Hub integration for calling global agents:
- `callAgent()`: Call an agent with prompt (120s timeout)
- `listAgents()`: List available agents
- `getAgent()`: Get specific agent details
- `listAllAgents()`: List all agents across projects
- Connects to http://localhost:3847

#### **app/utils/zip.ts**
`normalizeZipCode()`: Strips whitespace, removes US ZIP+4 suffix, uppercases.

#### **app/plans.ts** (118 lines)
**Plan tiers:** free, starter, pro, ultimate

### API ROUTES (Public, CORS-enabled)

#### **app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx** (329 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET/POST /api/zip-check?shop=...&zip=...`

Checks if a zip code is serviceable:
- Returns allowed status, message, ETA, zone, COD, return policy, delivery fee
- Delivery date calculation based on business days and delivery schedule
- Delivery rule matching (explicit zip > zone match, by priority)
- Default behavior for unlisted zips (block/allow)
- Social proof: waitlist count for unavailable zips
- Cache: 60s for allowed, 5s for denied
- Sanitizes merchant messages

**Response:**
```json
{
  "allowed": true/false,
  "message": "...",
  "eta": "2-3 days",
  "zone": "Zone A",
  "codAvailable": true,
  "returnPolicy": "30 days",
  "cutoffTime": "14:00",
  "daysOfWeek": "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri",
  "estimatedDeliveryDate": "2026-04-10",
  "deliveryFee": 5.99,
  "freeShippingAbove": 50.00,
  "showWaitlist": true,
  "waitlistCount": 3
}
```

#### **app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx** (193 lines)
**Endpoint:** `POST /api/waitlist`

Adds customer to waitlist for unavailable zip codes:
- Validates shop, zip, email (length, format)
- Plan gating: checks maxWaitlist limit
- Upsert to DB (prevents duplicates)
- Fire-and-forget emails: customer confirmation + merchant alert
- Rate limiting: plan-based (50 for Starter, unlimited for Pro/Ultimate)

**Request:**
```json
{ "shop": "store.myshopify.com", "zip": "12345", "email": "customer@example.com", "name": "John Doe" }
```

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "You've been added to the waitlist!" }
```

#### **app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx** (189 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET /api/widget-config?shop=...`

Returns widget configuration for storefront blocks:
- Plan-gated features stripped server-side
- Sanitized custom CSS (removes </style>, @import, expression(), javascript:, data: URIs)
- Includes position, colors, text, toggles (ETA, COD, return policy, delivery fee, etc.)
- No-cache headers

**Response:**
```json

  "position": "inline",
  "primaryColor": "#008060",
  "successColor": "#008060",
  "errorColor": "#D72C0D",
  "heading": "Check Delivery Availability",
  "placeholder": "Enter your zip code",
  "buttonText": "Check",
  "successMessage": "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  "showEta": true,
  "showCod": true,
  "blockCartOnInvalid": false,
  "customCss": "/* sanitized CSS */"
}
```
